title: Cloud Parkoor jump
description:
This is a whimsical 2D platformer where you'll leap, bounce, and glide across a dreamlike sky world. Master your jumps to navigate fluffy marshmallow clouds and springy mushroom platforms, all while on a vital quest.

• Traverse a vibrant, pastel-colored world filled with unique airborne challenges.
• Experience intuitive touch controls for precise jumping and movement.
